findings.current: Blood burst from a terrible scream
findings.defect: This wording makes the scream sound like the source of the blood. The Korean says blood burst out amid terrible screams.
findings.rationale: The Korean phrase “끔찍한 비명과 함께 터져 나온 핏물” describes blood bursting out together with terrible screams, not blood bursting from a scream.
findings.replacement: Blood burst out amid terrible screams and splashed across his face.

summary: One minor physical-causality defect: the English makes it sound as though blood came from a scream.
